captions.formal: An orange fluffy kitten walks forward through a wooded area with dirt ground and green foliage, lifting its right front paw with each step.
captions.sarcastic: A masterclass in stealth: the orange kitten attempts to vanish behind a few thin branches before deciding to walk forward.
captions.humorous_tech: Orange kitten deploying to production, moving through the foliage with the cautious latency of a developer who forgot to run the tests.
captions.humorous_non_tech: This orange fluffball is navigating the woods with the extreme caution of a tiny explorer who suspects the dirt might be plotting against him.
